name: @w6w-apps/pardot
description: Manage prospects, lists, tags, campaigns and marketing assets in Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) through API v5.

w6w.longDescription:
Pardot, now Salesforce Account Engagement, is Salesforce's B2B marketing automation platform. This app brings its prospect database into a workflow on the current API v5: create, update, upsert by email and delete prospects, tag them, and move them on and off lists.

Query actions cover the rest of what a marketing workflow needs to look up first — campaigns, prospect accounts, custom fields, forms, form handlers, landing pages and sent emails — plus visitors and visitor activities, so a workflow can react to what a prospect actually did. Every query pages with the API's own page token and defaults to a useful field list that you can widen, including custom fields.

Connect with Salesforce OAuth (production or sandbox) or a pasted access token, together with your business unit id. A health check tracks Account Engagement's own Salesforce Trust status and whether the API host is answering.
